items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you also make "Sam Jones Done Snagged His Britches?" [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I made that too.

ctx.x: They were the first ones, the first recordings of his group.
Yeah, I remember we had "Doug the Jitterbug" and "Flatface" was the other side. My brother had that record. It was one of my favorites. Did you also make "Sam Jones Done Snagged His Britches?"
